title: Instruction template bound
statement: For a finite binary Turing machine $M$, the instruction template bound is $L_{\max}(M)+3$, where $L_{\max}(M)$ is the maximum length of its instruction templates.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
